error_field_target: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: the storage files move to, when they're moved between storages. Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_field_target_id: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: the role or member a room's permission settings are for. Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_field_target_type: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: what a setting is for: a Space, a room or a chat (a notification setting), or a role or a member (a room's permission settings). Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_field_token: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: the code in a link from one of Duvet's emails, to verify an address, reset a password or change an email address. Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_field_type: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: the kind of what's sent: a message's, a chat's or an interaction's. The app fills it in, not the person. Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_field_user_id: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: a person's user ID, typed to add a friend, or picked. Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_field_username: A field's name, in the list of missing fields (error_validation_required), and in the other case of the error_validation_ sentences: a person's username, or the name a webhook's messages show. Write it as a bare label, with no article, in lower case unless your language capitalizes it (German nouns).
error_file_unopenable: An emoji's or a sticker's uploaded file that Duvet couldn't open. The English is the API's own words.
error_file_unreadable: A picture uploaded for a profile, a bot or a Space that Duvet couldn't read. The English is the API's own words.
error_friend_request_gone: The friend request was taken back, accepted or declined meanwhile.
error_friend_request_to_bot: A bot account can't be sent a friend request.
error_group_members_missing: Starting a group chat: pick the people in it.
error_icon_too_large: A Space's icon over 10 MB. MB is the unit's symbol. The English is the API's own words.
error_image_over_kib: An emoji's or a sticker's image is over the largest file a Space takes for one. {kind} picks the case: emoji, or (other) sticker. {kib} is that largest size in kibibytes (KiB, 1,024 bytes). The English is the API's own words.
error_image_too_large: A profile's picture (its avatar or banner) over 10 MB. MB is the unit's symbol. The English is the API's own words.
error_interaction_failed: A person used a bot's command, button or form, and the bot's answer couldn't be used. The application is the bot's. The English is the API's own words.
error_interaction_no_response: A person used a bot's command, button or form, and the bot didn't answer in time. The application is the bot's. The English is the API's own words.
error_interaction_room_hidden: An interaction is a bot's command or button that a person used. The bot's answer can't go to a room that person can no longer see.
error_internal: Duvet's side: the problem was Duvet's, not the person's.
error_invalid_id: An ID in what the app sent (a room's, a message's) that Duvet couldn't read.
error_invite_limit: Invites that work: ones neither expired nor revoked. Revoke: cancel an invite link so it stops working.
error_link_expired: A link from one of Duvet's emails: to verify an address, reset a password or change an email address.
error_manage_higher_role: Editing a role, or giving or taking it, when it's as high as, or higher than, your highest role in the Space's list.
error_member_not_found: A Space's member, who left or was removed meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_message_not_found: A message deleted meanwhile: opening it from a link or a search, editing it, or reacting to it. The English is the API's own words.
error_message_sent_then_deleted: A message sent again whose first sending went through, and was then deleted. A nonce is the ID the app gives a message it sends. The English is the API's own words.
error_message_still_sending: A message sent again while its first sending is still on its way: try again in a moment. A nonce is the ID the app gives a message it sends, to know it when it comes back. The English is the API's own words.
error_modal_gone: A bot's form (a modal) that expired, or was sent already. The English is the API's own words.
error_name_missing: A form that needs a name: a Space's, a room's, a role's.
error_network_failed: A request to Duvet failed on the network: no connection, or the server couldn't be reached. It's shown for any request that failed so, in every browser engine (WebKit's own words are "Load failed"). In English, the same words as Chromium's own error for it.
error_no_answer: A request to Duvet got no answer in time. The server is Duvet's own, not a Space.
error_no_permission_ban: Banning: removing members from a Space and keeping them out (the Ban Members permission).
error_no_permission_create_invites: Making an invite link to the Space (the Create Invites permission).
error_no_permission_delete_message: Deleting someone else's message in a room of a Space (the Manage Messages permission).
error_no_permission_kick: Kicking: removing members from a Space, who can join it again (the Kick Members permission).
error_no_permission_manage_attachments: The files sent in the Space: deleting them, or moving them between its storages (the Manage Attachments permission).
error_no_permission_manage_bots: Adding bots to the Space or removing them (the Manage Bots permission).
error_no_permission_manage_buckets: The Space's storage buckets: S3-compatible storage it set up for its files (the Manage Buckets permission).
error_no_permission_manage_emojis: Adding, renaming or removing the Space's custom emojis (the Manage Emojis permission).
error_no_permission_manage_invites: Listing or revoking the Space's invite links (the Manage Invites permission).
error_no_permission_manage_roles: Making, editing, giving or taking a Space's roles (the Manage Roles permission).
error_no_permission_manage_room_permissi: A room of a Space's permission settings: who can see it and do what in it (the Manage Rooms permission).
error_no_permission_manage_rooms: Making, editing, moving or deleting a Space's rooms (the Manage Rooms permission).
error_no_permission_manage_space: Changing the Space's own settings (the Administrator permission). The Space is the one the person is in.
error_no_permission_manage_stickers: Adding, renaming or removing the Space's stickers (the Manage Stickers permission).
error_no_permission_manage_webhooks: Making, editing or deleting the Space's webhooks (the Manage Webhooks permission).
error_no_permission_pin: Pinning or unpinning a message, in the room of a Space the message is in (the Pin Messages permission).
error_no_permission_send: A room of a Space where the person's roles don't let them send messages (the Send Messages permission), a read-only room for one.
error_no_permission_view_room: A room of a Space the person's roles don't let them see (the View Rooms permission).
error_not_a_bot: Adding an account to a Space as a bot, when the account is a person's.
error_not_friends_with_everyone: Starting a group chat or adding people to one: everyone added must be the person's friend.
error_not_team_admin: The developer features: only the team's admins can do this. The English is the API's own words.
error_not_team_member: The developer features: the person isn't in this team of developers. The English is the API's own words.
error_notice_not_editable: A notice: the line a room or chat shows when someone pins a message, or a call starts or ends. It can't be edited. The English is the API's own words.
error_notice_not_pinnable: A notice: the line a room or chat shows when someone pins a message, or a call starts or ends. It can't be pinned. The English is the API's own words.
error_notification_title: A browser notification's title: {name} is who wrote the message, {place} the room or chat it's in (e.g. #general · Alpha).
error_notification_without_text: A system notification's text for a message that has none (only files or a sticker). Clicking the notification opens the message.
error_overwrite_not_found: An overwrite: a room's permission setting for one role or member, which overrides the role's own. It was removed meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_overwrite_target_unknown: A room's permission settings were for something that is neither a role nor a member of the Space.
error_password_reset_failed: Setting a new password from the link in its email.
error_pin_limit: A room or a chat holds 250 pinned messages at most. The English is the API's own words.
error_profile_not_saved: Duvet's side couldn't save the person's profile. The English is the API's own words.
error_reaction_people_not_loaded: Duvet's side couldn't list who reacted with an emoji. The English is the API's own words.
error_remove_higher_role: Kicking or banning: removing someone from a Space. Each member's highest role is the one highest in the Space's list of roles.
error_remove_yourself: Removing people from a group chat: the owner can't remove themselves.
error_remove_yourself_from_space: Kicking or banning: removing someone from a Space.
error_rename_groups_only: A direct message can't be renamed; a group chat can.
error_reply_target_not_found: Replying to a message that was deleted meanwhile. Referenced message: the one replied to. The English is the API's own words.
error_request_failed: Duvet refused a request without saying why. {status} is the HTTP status code, e.g. 502.
error_request_too_large: What the app sent is over 32 MiB, the most Duvet takes. MiB is the unit's symbol (mebibyte). The English is the API's own words.
error_reset_email_not_sent: The email with a link to reset a forgotten password, asked for from the sign-in page.
error_reset_password_email_not_sent: The email with a link to set a new password, asked for from Settings while signed in.
error_role_not_found: A Space's role, deleted meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_room_parent_not_category: Making or moving a room: the category it goes in must be one of the same Space's. parent_id is the API's name for that category: say it in words. The API writes space in lower case; write Space as GLOSSARY.md does. The English is the API's own words.
error_search_empty: A message search with neither words nor a filter (from:, in:, has:). The English is the API's own words.
error_search_timeout: A message search took too long: narrow it down with more words or filters. The English is the API's own words.
error_session_account_gone: The account this device is signed in to no longer exists. User: an account. The English is the API's own words.
error_session_account_not_loaded: Duvet's side couldn't read the signed-in person's account. The English is the API's own words.
error_session_check_failed: Duvet's side couldn't check the person's sign-in: its database failed. The English is the API's own words.
error_session_expired: The person's sign-in on this device has expired: they sign in again. The English is the API's own words.
error_session_invalid: The person's sign-in on this device isn't valid any more, or has expired: they sign in again. The English is the API's own words.
error_session_no_access_token: The app sent a request without the person's proof of sign-in (the access token, sent with each request). The English is the API's own words.
error_session_no_session_token: The app sent a request without the person's session token (what keeps them signed in on this device). The English is the API's own words.
error_session_refresh_failed: Shown when the app couldn't renew the person's session. {status} is the HTTP status code, e.g. 500.
error_session_token_mismatch: The proof of sign-in sent with a request (the access token) is another session's than this device's. The English is the API's own words.
error_sign_in_failed: Signing in failed without a reason from Duvet.
error_sign_up_failed: Signing up: creating a new account.
error_sign_up_failed_because: Signing up: creating a new account. {reason} is why, in the words of the error that stopped it, e.g. the error_network_failed message.
error_space_limit: 100 is the most Spaces a person can be in.
error_space_no_bucket: A storage bucket is S3-compatible storage a Space set up for its files.
error_space_no_default_storage: Storage is where a Space's files are kept: Duvet's own, or a bucket the Space set up.
error_sticker_not_found: A sticker, deleted meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_sticker_not_here: A sticker from a Space this room isn't in, or one deleted meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_storage_status_not_loaded: Duvet's side couldn't read how much of the storage is used. The English is the API's own words.
error_team_delete_owner_only: The developer features: only the team's owner can delete it. The English is the API's own words.
error_team_edit_owner_only: The developer features: only the team's owner can edit it. The English is the API's own words.
error_team_invite_bot: The developer features: a bot account can't be invited to a team. The English is the API's own words.
error_team_invite_not_found: The developer features: an invite to a team, taken back or answered meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_team_not_found: The developer features: a team (developers who share applications), deleted meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_team_owner_cannot_be_removed: The developer features: the team's owner can't be removed from it. The English is the API's own words.
error_text_unstorable: Text with characters Duvet can't keep: the NUL character (U+0000), or bytes that aren't UTF-8. Keep NUL, U+0000 and UTF-8 as they are. The English is the API's own words.
error_too_large: What the person is sending is over the size Duvet takes. {what} is message (a message with its files) or files. {size} is its size, {over} how much of it is over, {limit} the limit: each a size, e.g. 33.00 MB.
error_transfer_bucket_changed: A storage bucket of a move of files changed as the move began: start it again. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_ended: The move of files between storages (the transfer) has ended. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_keep_source_needs_bucket: Moving files and keeping them where they were too works only from a storage bucket. keep_source is the API's name for that choice: say it in words. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_no_room: Moving files between storages: the target (where they go) has no room for them. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_not_found: A move of files between storages (a transfer), ended or cancelled meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_running: Files are being moved between storages already: one move at a time. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_same_storage: Moving files between storages: the source (where they are) and the target (where they go) must differ. The English is the API's own words.
error_transfer_storage_invalid: Moving files between storages: the source (where they are) and the target (where they go) are each "default" (Duvet's own storage) or a storage bucket's ID. Keep "default" as it is. The English is the API's own words.
error_unreadable_request: Duvet couldn't read what the app sent.
error_upload_aborted: An upload was stopped before it finished.
error_upload_failed_bucket_moved: An upload failed: its storage bucket's address changed while the file went up, so upload it again. {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_failed_bucket_removed: An upload failed: its storage bucket was removed while the file went up, so upload it again. {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_failed_file_too_large: An upload failed: the file is over the largest file allowed where it goes. {whose} picks the case: bucket, the limit set on the storage bucket it goes to; other, the person's own limit (your limit). {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. {size} is the file's size and {limit} the limit, both a number of bytes. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_failed_storage_error: An upload failed: the storage (Duvet's own, or a storage bucket) refused the file or failed. {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_failed_storage_full: An upload failed: the storage the file goes to (the person's, the Space's or a storage bucket) has no room left for it. {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_failed_storage_no_answer: An upload failed: the storage (Duvet's own, or a storage bucket) didn't answer in time. {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_failed_too_slow: An upload failed: it took too long, and its file wasn't kept, so upload it again. {what} picks the case, what was uploaded: avatar, a person's, a bot's or a webhook's picture; banner, a profile's or a Space's; icon, a Space's; other, an attachment: a message's file, or a Space's emoji or sticker. Each case is the whole sentence. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_limit_invalid: The largest file a storage bucket takes must be a number above 0. upload_limit_bytes is the API's name for that limit: say it in words. The English is the API's own words.
error_upload_stalled: An upload stopped sending. {seconds} is a number of seconds; s is the unit's symbol.
error_user_id_missing: Adding a friend by their user ID.
error_username_empty: Signing up: the username was left empty. The English is the API's own words.
error_username_too_long: Editing the profile: a username has 32 characters at most. The English is the API's own words.
error_validation_enter_own: A sign-in or sign-up form sent without some of the person's own details. Each case names which are missing; other is all three: username, email and password.
error_validation_invalid: A form or request with a field whose value isn't one the field takes. {field} picks the case: the field the API refused, each case a whole sentence, so it can agree with that field as your language needs. A case's name is the field's error_field_ key without error_field_; its English, that message's. other is a field with no case: {name} is its name, in the app's language (an error_field_ message) or, for a field the app doesn't know, its English name. It can be any field, of any gender: phrase other so nothing has to agree with it, e.g. French "Le champ « {name} » n’est pas valide". The app writes the sentence's first letter as a capital.
error_validation_invalid_id: A form or request with a field that should be an ID and isn't. {field} picks the case: the field the API refused, each case a whole sentence, so it can agree with that field as your language needs. A case's name is the field's error_field_ key without error_field_; its English, that message's. other is a field with no case: {name} is its name, in the app's language (an error_field_ message) or, for a field the app doesn't know, its English name. It can be any field, of any gender: phrase other so nothing has to agree with it, e.g. French "Le champ « {name} » n’est pas un ID valide". The app writes the sentence's first letter as a capital.
error_validation_required: A form or request sent without two or more fields it needs. {fields} is the list of their names in the app's language (error_field_ messages), joined as the language joins a list (e.g. "bucket name and access key ID"). The names can be of any gender, or English for a field the app doesn't know: phrase the sentence so nothing has to agree with them or their number, e.g. French "Champs requis : {fields}". The app writes the sentence's first letter as a capital.
error_validation_required_one: A form or request sent without a field it needs. {field} picks the case: the field the API refused, each case a whole sentence, so it can agree with that field as your language needs. A case's name is the field's error_field_ key without error_field_; its English, that message's. other is a field with no case: {name} is its name, in the app's language (an error_field_ message) or, for a field the app doesn't know, its English name. It can be any field, of any gender: phrase other so nothing has to agree with it, e.g. French "Le champ « {name} » est requis". The app writes the sentence's first letter as a capital.
error_validation_too_long: A form or request with a field that is too long. {field} picks the case: the field the API refused, each case a whole sentence, so it can agree with that field as your language needs. A case's name is the field's error_field_ key without error_field_; its English, that message's. other is a field with no case: {name} is its name, in the app's language (an error_field_ message) or, for a field the app doesn't know, its English name. It can be any field, of any gender: phrase other so nothing has to agree with it, e.g. French "Le champ « {name} » est trop long". The app writes the sentence's first letter as a capital.
error_validation_too_short: A form or request with a field that is too short, or a number too small. {field} picks the case: the field the API refused, each case a whole sentence, so it can agree with that field as your language needs. A case's name is the field's error_field_ key without error_field_; its English, that message's. other is a field with no case: {name} is its name, in the app's language (an error_field_ message) or, for a field the app doesn't know, its English name. It can be any field, of any gender: phrase other so nothing has to agree with it, e.g. French "Le champ « {name} » est trop court". The app writes the sentence's first letter as a capital.
error_value_too_long: Something typed (a name, an address) is longer than Duvet keeps. The English is the API's own words.
error_verification_email_not_sent: The email with a link that verifies the person's email address.
error_webhook_not_found: A webhook (an address that posts messages to a room), deleted meanwhile. The English is the API's own words.
error_wrong_credentials: Signing in: the email address or the password is wrong.
format_size_bytes: [short] A file's size under a kilobyte. {size} is the number, written in the language's digits.
format_size_kb: [short] A file's size in kilobytes, e.g. 12.5 KB. Use your language's unit (French: Ko).
format_size_mb: [short] A file's size in megabytes, e.g. 3.25 MB. Use your language's unit (French: Mo).
keys_alt: [short] The Alt key's name, on a key cap in the keyboard shortcuts sheet (not on macOS, which shows ⌥).
keys_alt_click: [short] A click with the Alt key held, in a menu item's shortcut hint (not on macOS).
keys_anything: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the shortcut that opens the quick switcher, to go anywhere by typing its name.
keys_chat_step: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that go to the next or the previous open chat.
keys_ctrl: [short] The Control key's name, as the keyboard writes it, on a key cap (not on macOS, which shows ⌘). German: Strg.
keys_ctrl_click: [short] A click with the Control key held, in a menu item's shortcut hint (not on macOS). German: Strg-Klick.
keys_ctrl_shift_with: [short] A shortcut: Control, Shift and a letter, as a tooltip or a key cap writes it. {key} is the letter, e.g. M.
keys_ctrl_with: [short] A shortcut: Control and a letter, as a tooltip or a key cap writes it. {key} is the letter, e.g. K.
keys_edit: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that edits the user's own message under the cursor.
keys_either: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet, between two sets of key caps that do the same: <single> holds the single key (keyboard navigation), <shortcut> the shortcut with a modifier. The tags hold no words: keep both, in the order your language puts them.
keys_esc: [short] The Escape key's name, on a key cap.
keys_go_to: [short] A heading of the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that go somewhere.
keys_leave_box: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that leaves the message box, to move around with single keys.
keys_mac_click: [short] A click with a key held, on macOS, in a menu item's shortcut hint. {key} is the key's symbol, ⌘ or ⌥.
keys_mark: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that shows a letter on each row and message, typed to jump there.
keys_message_step: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that move to the next or the previous message.
keys_messages: [short] A heading of the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys for a chat's messages.
keys_newest: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that goes to the newest message.
keys_next_unread: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the keys that go to the next chat with unread messages.
keys_open_chat: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the digits that open the open chats 1 to 8, and 9 the last one.
keys_reply: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that replies to the message under the cursor. A verb.
keys_sheet_again: The last line of the keyboard shortcuts sheet: <single> holds the ? key cap, <shortcut> the ⌘/ or Ctrl / key caps. The tags hold no words: keep both.
keys_sheet_close: The keyboard shortcuts sheet's close button, for a screen reader.
keys_sheet_note_off: Under the keyboard shortcuts sheet's title, while keyboard navigation is off. Settings and Appearance are the names of Settings and its Appearance page.
keys_sheet_note_on: Under the keyboard shortcuts sheet's title, while keyboard navigation is on. Esc is the Escape key.
keys_shift: [short] The Shift key's name, on a key cap (not on macOS, which shows ⇧).
keys_write: In the keyboard shortcuts sheet: the key that goes back to writing in the message box.
media_bot_badge: [short] A badge after a bot's name on a bot's invite card. English writes it in capitals.
media_bot_invite_add: Button on the card a bot's invite link shows in a message: picks a Space to add the bot to.
media_bot_invite_title: Heading of the card a bot's invite link shows in a message.
media_crop_apply: [short] Button of the crop dialog: crops the picture and uses it. Verb.
media_crop_change: [short] Button of the crop dialog: picks another picture.
media_crop_choose: In the crop dialog's empty drop area, before a picture is picked.
media_crop_formats: Under the crop dialog's drop area: the pictures it takes, and how large. Write MB as your language does (French: Mo).
media_crop_hint: Above the picture in the crop dialog: how to move it in the frame and zoom it.
media_crop_processing: [short] The crop dialog's Apply button while the cropped picture is being made.
media_crop_title: Title of the dialog that crops a picture before it's uploaded (an avatar, a banner, an emoji), when what opened it gave none.
media_crop_zoom: The crop dialog's zoom slider, for a screen reader. Noun.
media_edited_marker: After a message's text, in small type, in brackets. {edited} is chat_message_edited (edited) or chat_message_edited_ago (edited 5 minutes ago, edited just now), already in your language. Write the brackets as your language does.
media_emoji_categories: Names the emoji picker's row of category tabs, for a screen reader.
media_emoji_load_failed: Tooltip on a custom emoji's name, which shows in its place when its picture couldn't load.
media_emoji_picker: Names the emoji picker's popover, for a screen reader.
media_emoji_recent: [short] The emoji picker's first tab (its tooltip) and the heading above it: the emojis used lately.
media_emoji_search: [short] The emoji picker's search field: its placeholder, and its name for a screen reader.
media_gif_attribution: Under the GIF picker's results: KLIPY's attribution, which its guidelines require. Keep KLIPY as it is.
media_gif_empty: In the GIF picker when KLIPY gives no GIF for the search.
media_gif_load_failed: In the GIF picker when KLIPY couldn't be reached, above a Try again button.
media_gif_picker: The GIF picker's heading, and its name for a screen reader.
media_gif_retry: [short] Button in the GIF picker after a failure: asks KLIPY for the GIFs again.
media_gif_search: [short] The GIF picker's search placeholder, and its name for a screen reader. KLIPY's attribution guidelines require it to name KLIPY: keep KLIPY as it is.
media_gif_send: A GIF in the picker, for a screen reader: pressing it sends it. {title} is the GIF's title, as KLIPY gives it.
media_gif_send_untitled: A GIF without a title in the picker, for a screen reader: pressing it sends it.
media_gif_timeout: In the GIF picker when KLIPY didn't answer in time, above a Try again button.
media_image: The image viewer's title, for a screen reader, when the image has no description.
media_image_close: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's close button. Esc in brackets is the key that does the same: write it as your language's keyboards do.
media_image_named: The image viewer's title, for a screen reader. {name} is the image's description or its file's name.
media_image_reset: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's button that puts the image back as it opened. (0) is the key that does the same.
media_image_rotate_left: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's button that turns the image a quarter turn anticlockwise. ([) is the key that does the same.
media_image_rotate_right: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's button that turns the image a quarter turn clockwise. (]) is the key that does the same.
media_image_zoom_in: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's zoom-in button. (+) is the key that does the same.
media_image_zoom_out: [short] Tooltip of the image viewer's zoom-out button. (-) is the key that does the same.
media_invite_join: [short] Button on the card an invite link shows in a message: joins the Space. Verb.
media_invite_join_failed: Under an invite's card when joining failed and the API gave no reason.
media_invite_joined: On an invite's card, in place of its Join button, once the person has joined the Space.
media_invite_joining: [short] The invite card's Join button while the request is on its way.
media_invite_members: Under the Space's name on an invite's card: how many members the Space has.
media_invite_title: Heading of the card an invite link shows in a message.
media_link_direct_message: In the card a link to a message shows: in place of the conversation's name, for one with no name.
media_link_loading: In the card a link to a message shows, while that message loads.
media_link_unknown_room: In the card a link to a message shows: in place of the name of a room the app doesn't know. Written as a room's name is, lowercase with hyphens.
media_now_playing: Names, for a screen reader, the bar at the bottom of the sidebar that shows the voice note playing.
media_open_image: For a screen reader: a link preview's image, which opens in the image viewer when pressed.
media_pause: [short] A player's button, for a screen reader: pauses the voice note or audio file playing. Verb.
media_picker_no_results: In the emoji and sticker pickers when the search finds nothing. {query} is what the person typed.
media_play: [short] A player's button, for a screen reader: plays the voice note, audio file or video. Verb.
media_play_named: A video's play button, for a screen reader. {title} is the video's title, as its page gives it.
media_playback_rate: [short] The text of a player's speed button: {rate} times the normal speed, e.g. 1.5x.
media_playback_speed: A player's speed button, for a screen reader. {rate} is the speed, e.g. 1.5: the x after it means times.
media_reaction_add: [short] Tooltip of the button after a message's reactions, and its name for a screen reader: opens the emoji picker to react.
media_reactions_title: Title of the dialog that shows who reacted to a message, and the name of its list of reactions for a screen reader.
media_reactions_who: Names, for a screen reader, the list of the people who reacted with the chosen emoji.
media_reactor_unknown: In place of a person's name while the app can't tell who they are: someone who reacted to a message, in the list of who reacted.
media_search_clear: The × in a picker's search field, for a screen reader: empties the field. Verb.
media_search_results: [short] Heading above the emoji picker's search results.
media_seek: Names a player's progress line, for a screen reader: pressing it, or the arrow keys, moves through the audio. Verb.
media_seek_position: Read out on a player's progress line by a screen reader. {position} is how far it has played and {duration} how long it is, both as a clock, e.g. 1:05.
media_spoiler: [short] On the cover over a spoiler, which a click takes away. English writes it in capitals.
media_sticker: A sticker with no name, for a screen reader. Noun.
media_sticker_empty: In the sticker picker when no Space of the person's has stickers.
media_sticker_picker: Names the sticker picker's popover, for a screen reader.
media_sticker_search: [short] The sticker picker's search field: its placeholder, and its name for a screen reader.
media_stop: [short] A button of the voice note bar, for a screen reader: stops the voice note and closes the bar. Verb.
media_text_preview_contents: Names the box that holds a text file's contents, for a screen reader. {filename} is the file's name.
media_text_preview_copied: [short] Beside the copy button of a text file's preview for a moment, once the text is copied.
media_text_preview_copy: [short] Tooltip of the copy button of a text file's preview. Verb.
media_text_preview_copy_label: The copy button of a text file's preview, for a screen reader: copies the file's text.
media_text_preview_description: Under a text file's name, in the dialog that shows its contents: they can be read and copied, not changed.
media_text_preview_failed: In a text file's preview dialog when the file couldn't be read.
media_text_preview_loading: In a text file's preview dialog while the file is read.
media_text_preview_truncated: Under a long text file's preview. {size} is how much of it shows, e.g. 1 MB.
menu_about: [short] The app menu's first item on macOS: opens the About window. {name} is the app's name, Duvet. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_bring_all_to_front: [short] The menu bar's Window menu: brings every window of the app forward. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_close_window: [short] The menu bar's Window menu: closes the window in front (⇧⌘W). Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_copy: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu: a verb, copies the selection. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_cut: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu: a verb, cuts the selection. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_docs: [short] The menu bar's Help menu: opens Duvet's documentation in the browser. {name} is the app's name, Duvet.
menu_edit: [short] The name of the menu bar's Edit menu on macOS. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_help: [short] The name of the menu bar's Help menu on macOS. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_hide: [short] The app menu on macOS: hides the app's windows (⌘H). {name} is the app's name, Duvet. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_hide_others: [short] The app menu on macOS: hides every other app's windows. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_minimize: [short] The menu bar's Window menu: a verb, minimizes the window into the Dock. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_paste: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu: a verb. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_paste_and_match_style: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu: pastes text without its formatting. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_quit: [short] The app menu on macOS: quits the app (⌘Q). {name} is the app's name, Duvet. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_redo: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu: a verb. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_select_all: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_settings: [short] The app menu on macOS: opens Settings (⌘,). Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_show_all: [short] The app menu on macOS: shows the windows of every app again. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_toggle_full_screen: [short] The menu bar's View menu: enters full screen, or leaves it. macOS may show its own Enter Full Screen or Exit Full Screen there instead.
menu_undo: [short] The menu bar's Edit menu: a verb. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_view: [short] The name of the menu bar's View menu on macOS. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_window: [short] The name of the menu bar's Window menu on macOS. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
menu_zoom: [short] The menu bar's Window menu: a verb, makes the window fill the screen or puts it back. Use the words macOS itself uses for this item in your language, as every Mac app's menu bar does.
mod_ban_banning: [short] The ban button while the ban is on its way.
mod_ban_cancel: [short] The ban dialog's button that closes it without banning.
mod_ban_confirm: [short] The ban dialog's button: ban the member. A verb.
mod_ban_description: Under the ban dialog's title. {space} is the Space's name.
mod_ban_done: A notice once a member was banned. {name} is their name.
mod_ban_failed: A notice when the ban didn't go through and the API gave no reason. "them" is the member.
mod_ban_reason_count: [short] How many characters the reason has, of the most it takes. Beside the reason field's label. {count} is how many it has; {max} is the most it takes (512).
mod_ban_reason_label: [short] The label of the ban's reason field. <muted>…</muted> is drawn in a lighter weight: keep the tags around the word for optional.
mod_ban_reason_placeholder: The reason field's placeholder: the reason is shown to the Space's moderators in the list of bans, not to the banned member.
mod_ban_reason_too_long: Under the reason field when it's too long. {max} is the most characters a reason takes (512).
mod_ban_title: The ban dialog's title. {name} is the member's name.
mod_kick_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before kicking a member from a Space, while that is on its way: mod_kick_confirm_button in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. The English is the button's label and an ellipsis.
mod_kick_confirm: Asked before kicking a member from a Space. {name} is the member's name, {space} the Space's name. Kicking removes them; unlike a ban, they can come back.
mod_kick_confirm_button: [short] The confirmation's button: kick (remove) the member from the Space. A verb.
mod_kick_done: A notice once a member was kicked. {name} is their name.
mod_kick_failed: A notice when the kick didn't go through and the API gave no reason. "them" is the member.
os_camera_usage: macOS's prompt asking to let Duvet use the camera, the first time video is turned on. One sentence, in the system's language: it shows under the system's own question.
os_desktop_comment: The line a Linux app launcher or menu shows beside or under Duvet's name, describing the app: a noun phrase, not a sentence. Duvet is the app's name.
os_microphone_usage: macOS's prompt asking to let Duvet use the microphone, the first time it's needed. One sentence, in the system's language: it shows under the system's own question.
people_activity_song: A song someone is listening to, on one line beside its icon (a friend's row, the Now section, a chat's header): {song} is its title and {artist} who it's by, as their music app reports them. Keep it short; the dash only separates them.
people_activity_spotify: Under a name in the members list while they play music on Spotify.
people_add_space_code_label: Label of the field where an invite's code or its address is pasted.
people_add_space_code_placeholder: Placeholder of the invite field: an example code, or an example address. Keep abc123 and invite?code=abc123 as they are: translate only the word between them.
people_add_space_create: [short] The Add a Space dialog's button that creates the Space. Verb.
people_add_space_creating: [short] The Create button's label while the Space is created.
people_add_space_description: Under the Add a Space dialog's title.
people_add_space_description_label: Label of the optional description field. The words inside <optional>…</optional> are drawn lighter: keep the tags around them.
people_add_space_description_placeholder: Placeholder of the description field when creating a Space.
people_add_space_mode: Read by screen readers: the switch between creating a Space and joining one.
people_add_space_name_label: Label of the name field when creating a Space. A red * follows it.
people_add_space_name_placeholder: Placeholder of the name field when creating a Space: an example name.
people_add_space_preview: [short] The button that shows the invite's Space before joining it. Verb.
people_add_space_tab_create: [short] One side of the Create/Join switch in Add a Space. Verb.
people_add_space_tab_join: [short] One side of the Create/Join switch in Add a Space. Verb.
people_ban_member: [short] A menu item, and a button on a profile: bans {name}, a person's name, from the Space.
people_bot_invite_added: A notice once a bot joined a Space. {space} is the Space's name.
people_bot_invite_added_unnamed: A notice once a bot joined a Space whose name isn't known.
people_bot_invite_loading: Read by screen readers while the bot's profile loads.
people_bot_invite_no_permission: In the Add a bot dialog when none of the user's Spaces lets them add one. Manage Bots is the name of a permission: write it as your language's permission list names it.
people_bot_invite_pick: Over the list of the user's Spaces in the Add a bot dialog.
people_conversation_activity: Under a person's name at the start of a direct message: what they're doing now. {text} is a song and its artist, or a game's name, as the app reports it. Keep the select's cases.
people_conversation_call: [short] The button at the start of a direct message or group that starts a call. Verb.
people_conversation_call_menu: Read by screen readers: the menu beside the call button, with Voice call and Video call.
people_conversation_call_options: Tooltip of the small arrow beside the call button, which opens Voice call and Video call.
people_conversation_calling_elsewhere: A bar over a chat while the user's own call in it is on another of their devices.
people_conversation_dm_fallback: A direct message's name when the other person's name isn't known yet.
people_conversation_group_fallback: A group chat's name when it has none.
people_conversation_join_call: A bar over a chat while a call goes on in it that the user isn't in: pressing it joins. Keep it short.
people_conversation_placeholder: Placeholder of the message box in a direct message or group. {name} is the person's or the group's name. Message is a verb.
people_conversation_start_call: Tooltip of the phone button in a chat's bar. Verb.
people_conversation_start_dm: At the top of a direct message's first messages. {name} is the other person's name.
people_conversation_status: Under a person's name at the start of a direct message: their status now. Keep the select's cases.
people_conversation_video_call: [short] A menu item: starts a call with cameras.
people_conversation_voice_call: [short] A menu item: starts a call without cameras.
people_display_name_prompt: Title of the dialog that changes the user's own display name, the name every Space and chat shows for them.
people_dm_send_failed: A notice when a message in a direct message or group couldn't be sent.
people_dm_voice_note_failed: A notice when a voice note in a direct message or group couldn't be sent.
people_flags_badges: Heading of the badges in Duvet staff's editor of a user's flags and badges. Noun, plural.
people_flags_flags: Heading of the flags in Duvet staff's editor of a user's flags and badges. Noun, plural.
people_flags_title: Title of Duvet staff's editor of a user's flags and badges.
people_flags_user: Under the flags editor's title. {id} is the user's ID, a long code.
people_friend_remove_confirm: A confirm dialog's question before ending a friendship. {name} is the friend's name. Its button is Remove.
people_friends_add: [short] The Friends page's button that opens the form to add a friend. Verb.
people_friends_add_title: Heading of the form that sends a friend request.
people_friends_back: [short] The button over a chat opened from the Friends page that goes back to it.
people_friends_empty_action: [short] The button under an empty list of friends or sent requests: opens the form to add one. Verb.
people_friends_empty_line: Under No friends yet, on the empty Friends page.
people_friends_group_heading: A heading of the friends list: {group} is Online or Offline (already translated) and {count} how many friends are in it. The number inside <num>…</num> is drawn in even-width digits: keep the tags around it.
people_friends_message: [short] Tooltip of a friend's button that opens the direct message with them. Verb.
people_friends_message_label: Read by screen readers: the button that opens the direct message with {name}, a friend's name. Message is a verb.
people_friends_no_match: Under the friends' search when nothing matches. {query} is what the user typed.
people_friends_online: Under the Friends page's title: how many friends are online. # is that number.
people_friends_remove: [short] Tooltip of a friend's button that ends the friendship. Verb.
people_friends_remove_label: Read by screen readers: the button that ends the friendship with {name}, a friend's name. Verb.
people_friends_search: Placeholder of the search over the friends list, also read by screen readers as its name.
people_friends_send_request: [short] The button that sends a friend request. Verb.
people_friends_sending: [short] The Send request button's label while it sends.
people_friends_tab_all: [short] A tab of the Friends page: every friend.
people_friends_tab_pending: [short] A tab of the Friends page: the friend requests the user got, waiting for their answer.
people_friends_tab_sent: [short] A tab of the Friends page: the friend requests the user sent, waiting for an answer.
people_friends_user_id: Placeholder of the field where a user's ID is typed to send them a friend request.
people_group_add_people: The button that adds friends to a group chat, and its tooltip. Verb.
people_group_add_people_title: Title of the dialog that adds friends to a group chat.
people_group_bar_add: [short] The group bar's button that adds friends to the group, beside its icon. Verb.
people_group_leave_action: [short] The button of the dialog that asks before leaving a group chat. Verb.
people_group_leave_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before leaving a group chat, while that is on its way: people_group_leave_action in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. The English is the button's label and an ellipsis.
people_group_leave_confirm: A confirm dialog's question before leaving a group chat.
people_group_leave_menu: [short] A menu item: leaves the group chat. Verb.
people_group_more: Tooltip of the … button in a group chat's bar, with Rename group and Leave group.
people_group_name_placeholder: Placeholder of the field where a group chat's new name is typed.
people_group_remove_confirm: A confirm dialog's question before the group's owner takes someone out of it. {name} is that person's name. Its button is Remove.
people_group_rename_menu: [short] A menu item: renames the group chat. Verb.
people_group_rename_prompt: Title of the dialog where a group chat's new name is typed.
people_invite_copied: [short] The Copy button's label for two seconds after the link was copied.
people_invite_copy: [short] The button that copies the invite link. Verb.
people_invite_copy_label: Read by screen readers: the button that copies the invite link. Verb.
people_invite_expire_after: Over the choices of how long a new invite link works (30 minutes, 1 hour… Never).
people_invite_expires: Under an invite link. {when} is when it stops working, as your language says a time from now: in 7 days.
people_invite_link: Read by screen readers: the field holding the new invite link, to select and copy. Invite is a noun here (the invite's link), not a verb.
people_invite_loading: Read by screen readers while an invite, and the Space it's for, loads.
people_invite_making: Read by screen readers while a new invite link is made.
people_invite_never: [short] The last of the choices of how long a new invite link works: it never stops working.
people_invite_title: Title of the dialog that makes an invite link to a Space.
people_join_accept: [short] The button that joins the Space an invite is for. Verb.
people_join_joining: [short] The join button's label while the user joins.
people_join_member_count: Under a Space's name in an invite's preview: how many members it has. # is that number.
people_kick_member: [short] A menu item, and a button on a profile: removes {name}, a person's name, from the Space (they can join again).
people_member_menu: Read by screen readers: the menu a right-click on a person in a members list opens.
people_members_group: A heading of the members list: {group} is a role's name, or Online, Offline or Do not disturb (already translated), and {count} how many members are under it.
people_members_hide: Tooltip of the members button while the members column beside the chat is open. Verb.
people_members_label: Read by screen readers: the members button, which shows a few faces. # is how many members are online.
people_members_loading_more: Read by screen readers: the spinner under a members list while its next page loads.
people_members_online: Beside the members list's title: how many members are online. # is that number.
people_members_show: Tooltip of the members button while the members column beside the chat is closed. Verb.
people_members_title: Title of a chat's members list.
people_menu_accept_friend: [short] A menu item on a person who sent the user a friend request. Verb.
people_menu_add_friend: [short] A menu item on a person: sends them a friend request. Verb.
people_menu_call: [short] A menu item on a person: calls them in their direct message. Verb.
people_menu_copy_id: [short] A menu item on a person: copies their user ID. Verb.
people_menu_display_name: [short] A menu item on the user's own name in a members list. Verb.
people_menu_edit_flags: [short] A menu item for Duvet staff: opens the editor of a user's flags and badges. Verb.
people_menu_mention: [short] A menu item on a person: puts an @mention of them in the message box. Verb.
people_menu_message: [short] A menu item on a person: opens the direct message with them. Verb.
people_menu_profile: [short] A menu item on a person: opens their profile card. Noun.
people_menu_remove_friend: [short] A menu item on a friend: ends the friendship. Verb.
people_menu_roles: [short] A menu item on a member of a Space that opens the roles to give or take. Noun, plural.
people_new_chat_chosen: Beside the Friends label in the New chat dialog: how many friends are picked. # is that number.
people_new_chat_friends: Label over the list of friends to pick in the New chat dialog.
people_new_chat_start: [short] The New chat dialog's button when one friend is picked: opens the direct message with them. Verb.
people_new_chat_title: Title of the dialog that starts a chat, while one friend is picked.
people_new_group_create: [short] The New chat dialog's button while no friend or several friends are picked: makes a group chat (with none picked, pressing it asks for a friend). Verb.
people_new_group_name: Label of the group chat's name field.
people_new_group_name_placeholder: Placeholder of the group chat's name field: an example name.
people_new_group_title: Title of the New chat dialog while no friend or several friends are picked (it opens with none picked); with one picked it is New chat.
people_presence_dnd: Heading of the members who asked not to be disturbed, in a group's members list.
people_presence_offline: Heading of the people who aren't connected, in a members or friends list.
people_presence_online: Heading of the people who are connected, in a members or friends list.
people_profile_about: Heading of a person's bio on their profile card.
people_profile_accept: Tooltip of a profile card's button that accepts the friend request this person sent. Verb.
people_profile_add_friend: Tooltip of a profile card's button that sends a friend request. Verb.
people_profile_assign_roles: Heading of the roles the user can give this member or take from them, on their profile card.
people_profile_friends: Tooltip of a profile card's mark showing the user and this person are friends.
people_profile_hide_permissions: [short] A profile card's button that hides the list of the member's permissions. Verb.
people_profile_label: Read by screen readers: a person's profile card. {name} is their name.
people_profile_message: A profile card's button that opens the direct message with this person. Verb.
people_profile_request_sent: Tooltip of a profile card's mark after the user sent this person a friend request.
people_profile_retry: Tooltip of a profile card's button after a friend request failed: sends it again. Verb.
people_profile_role_locked: Tooltip of a role the user can't give or take, on a profile card.
people_profile_roles: Heading of the roles a member holds, on their profile card. Noun, plural.
people_profile_view_permissions: [short] A profile card's button that shows the list of the member's permissions. Verb.
people_remove_action: [short] The button of a dialog that asks before removing a friend or a group's member. Verb.
people_remove_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before removing a friend or a group's member, while that is on its way: people_remove_action in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. The English is the button's label and an ellipsis.
people_remove_from_group: [short] A menu item, and a button on a profile, for a group's owner: takes the person out of the group chat.
people_requests_accept: [short] A friend request's button that accepts it. Verb.
people_requests_decline: [short] Tooltip of a friend request's × button. Verb.
people_requests_decline_label: Read by screen readers: the button that declines {name}'s friend request. {name} is who sent it.
people_role_give_failed: A notice when giving a role failed. {name} is the member's name, {role} the role's name.
people_role_take_failed: A notice when taking a role away failed. {role} is the role's name, {name} the member's name.
people_sent_waiting: [short] Beside a friend request the user sent: it waits for an answer.
people_space_invite_in: Where the Join Space button was, once the user has joined the Space from this invite: they are now a member. Say it as your language confirms a join, not literally.
people_space_invite_join: [short] The button that joins the Space an invite is for. Verb.
people_space_invite_joined: A notice once the user joined a Space from an invite.
people_space_invite_member_count: Under a Space's name in an invite: how many members it has. # is that number. English capitalises Member here.
people_space_invite_title: Title of the dialog that shows a Space's invite.
people_tag_bot: [short] A small badge beside a bot's name. English writes it in capitals.
people_tag_webhook: [short] A small badge beside the name on a webhook's messages. English writes it in capitals.

perm_room_manage: A permission's name in a room's settings › Permissions: renaming this room and changing its description.
perm_room_view: A permission's name in a room's settings › Permissions, where a role's or member's overwrite allows or denies it in this one room.
perm_speak_in_voice: A permission's name: talking in voice rooms.

public_app_connecting: Beside a spinner while the app connects, before anything else shows.
public_app_open_chat_failed: A notice when a direct message with someone couldn't be opened or started.

public_download_page_title: The browser tab's title of the download page. Duvet is the app's name.

public_invite_bad_link: The invite link opened is broken: it has no invite code, or a wrong one.
public_invite_go_back: [short] A button on an invite that can't be used: goes back to the start page.

public_invite_join: [short] The invite card's button: join the Space (a verb).
public_invite_join_failed: Shown on the invite card when joining the Space failed.
public_invite_joining: [short] The invite card's button while the Space is being joined.
public_invite_loading: Beside a spinner while the invite is looked up.
public_invite_members: On the invite card: how many members the Space has, capitalised as a label. # is the number.
public_invite_not_now: [short] The invite card's last button: leave without joining.
public_invite_sign_in: [short] The invite card's button when signed out: sign in, then join the Space.
public_invite_sign_in_note: On the invite card when signed out, over the button "Sign in to join".
public_invite_unavailable: Heading when an invite link can't be used: it's wrong, expired or used up.
public_settings_window_title: The title of the Settings window. Duvet is the app's name.
public_space_settings_window_title: The title of a Space's settings window, before the Space's name is known.
public_space_settings_window_title_named: The title of a Space's settings window. {space} is the Space's name, as its people wrote it.
room_about_title: A heading in a room's settings › Overview, over its name and description.
room_delete: [short] At the bottom of a room's settings' sidebar: delete the room or category. kind: category or other (a room).
room_delete_cancel: [short] The confirmation's button that keeps the room or category.
room_delete_confirm: Asked under the delete button before deleting. kind: category or other (a room).
room_delete_confirm_button: [short] The confirmation's button: delete the room or category. A verb.
room_description_label: [short] The label of a room's description field.
room_description_placeholder: The placeholder of a room's description field.
room_name_label: [short] The label of the name field in a room's settings. kind: category (a group of rooms) or other (a room).
room_name_placeholder: The name field's placeholder: an example of a name, lowercase with hyphens as rooms' names are. kind: category or other (a room).

room_overwrite_all_added: In the + button's menu when every role is already in the list.
room_overwrite_pick: Where a role's permissions in this room show, when none is picked.
room_overwrite_remove: [short] A button: take the picked role or member off the list, so the Space's permissions apply again.
room_overwrites_empty: Under the list of roles and members when it's empty. Keep the +: it's the button's icon.
room_overwrites_title: [short] The heading of the list of roles and members whose permissions this room changes (its overwrites).

room_permission_allow_not_held: The tooltip of the allow button when it's unavailable: the API only takes a permission someone has in the room.
room_permission_deny: [short] The label and tooltip of a permission's deny button (an ×): refuse it in this room. One of Deny, Inherit, Allow.
room_permission_deny_not_held: The tooltip of the deny button when it's unavailable: the API only takes a permission someone has in the room.
room_permission_inherit: [short] The label and tooltip of a permission's middle button (a −): neither allow nor deny it in this room, so the Space's roles decide.
room_permissions_general: A heading in a room's settings › Permissions, over the permissions every kind of room has.
room_permissions_text: A heading in a room's settings › Permissions, over the permissions of text rooms (messages).
room_permissions_voice: A heading in a room's settings › Permissions, over the permissions of voice rooms (talking, video).
room_reset: [short] A button: undo the changes not saved yet.
room_save_failed: In a room's settings when saving its name, description or permissions failed and the API gave no reason.
room_section_overview: [short] A section of a room's (or category's) settings, in its sidebar: its name and description.
room_section_permissions: [short] A section of a room's settings, in its sidebar: what roles and members may do in this room.
room_section_webhooks: [short] A section of a text room's settings, in its sidebar: the room's webhooks (addresses other services post messages to).

room_settings_title: [short] Under the room's name at the top of its settings' sidebar. kind: category (a group of rooms) or other (a room).
room_unsaved_changes: On the bar that slides in at the bottom of a room's permissions while they have changes not saved yet.
room_webhook_avatar_change: [short] The tooltip of the camera button over a webhook's picture: pick a new picture.
room_webhook_avatar_hint: Beside the new webhook's picture: clicking the picture picks one.
room_webhook_avatar_label: [short] The label of a new webhook's picture, which its messages show.
room_webhook_avatar_remove: [short] The tooltip of the bin button over a webhook's picture: remove it.
room_webhook_cancel: [short] The label and tooltip of the × button that stops editing a webhook without saving.
room_webhook_copy_github_url: [short] A button: copy the webhook's address for GitHub. GitHub is a brand.

room_webhook_copy_url: [short] A button: copy the webhook's address.
room_webhook_copy_url_tooltip: The tooltip of the Copy URL button.
room_webhook_create: [short] The new webhook form's button. A verb.
room_webhook_create_title: A heading over the form that makes a new webhook.
room_webhook_created: Under a webhook's name in a room's settings. {date} is the day it was made.
room_webhook_creating: [short] The create button while the webhook is being made.

room_webhook_delete_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before deleting a webhook, while that is on its way: room_webhook_delete in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. The English is the button's label and an ellipsis.
room_webhook_delete_confirm: Asked before deleting a webhook. {name} is the webhook's name, the name its messages post under.

room_webhook_github_url_copied: A notice once the webhook's address for GitHub was copied. GitHub is a brand.
room_webhook_name_label: Read out for the field that renames a webhook.
room_webhook_rename: [short] The label and tooltip of a webhook's pencil button: edit its name and picture. A verb.
room_webhook_reset_token: [short] The label and tooltip of a webhook's button that gives it a new token, and the confirmation's button. A verb.
room_webhook_reset_token_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before giving a webhook a new token, while that is on its way: room_webhook_reset_token in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. room_webhook_reset_token_confirm: Asked before giving a webhook a new token: the secret part of its address, so the old address stops working.
room_webhook_room_label: [short] The label of the picker of the room a new webhook posts in.
room_webhook_save: [short] The label and tooltip of the ✓ button that saves a webhook's new name and picture. A verb.
room_webhook_token_dismiss: [short] A button: hide the box with the token.
room_webhook_token_reset_done: A notice once a webhook has its new token.

room_webhook_url_copied: A notice once the webhook's address was copied.

room_webhooks_empty_hint: Under room_webhooks_empty: the form to make one is above the list.

room_webhooks_note_any_room: Under the new webhook form's heading, when it can make one in any of several rooms.

settings_attachment_delete_confirm_unnam: Asks before deleting an uploaded file whose name isn't known.

settings_banner_change: Title of the dialog that crops the user's new profile banner.

settings_bot_image_remove: [short] Verb. Tooltip of the bin over a bot's avatar or banner: removes the image.

settings_bot_invite_link: Label before a bot's invite address.

settings_bot_token_reset: [short] Button: makes a new token for the bot.

settings_bot_token_show: [short] Verb. Tooltip of the eye button: shows the bot's token.
