space_invite_expires: Under an invite link: when it stops working. {date} is a date and time.
space_invite_revoke: [short] Button and confirmation button that make an invite link stop working. Verb.
space_invite_revoke_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before revoking an invite link, while that is on its way: space_invite_revoke in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. The English is the button's label and an ellipsis.
space_invite_room_deleted: Under an invite link, in place of the room it leads to when that room was deleted. Rooms are written with # before their name.
space_item_delete: [short] Button, tooltip and confirmation button that delete a role, an emoji, a sticker, a bucket or a file. Verb.
space_item_delete_busy: [short] The confirm button of the question before deleting a role, an emoji, a sticker, a bucket or a file of a Space, while that is on its way: space_item_delete in the form your language gives work in progress (Spanish: Eliminando…), with an ellipsis. The English is the button's label and an ellipsis.
space_item_edit: [short] Button and tooltip that edit a role, a bucket, or the Space's banner or icon. Verb.
space_item_rename: [short] Tooltip of the button that renames an emoji or a sticker. Verb.
space_member_back: [short] Button at the top of a member's details that goes back to the members list.
space_member_ban: [short] Button in a member's details: opens the dialog that bans them. Verb.
space_member_joined: [short] When a member joined the Space: the column heading above the dates in Space settings › Members, and the label of the date in a member's details.
space_member_joined_unknown: In a member's details, in place of the date they joined when it isn't known yet.
space_member_kick: [short] Button in a member's details: kicks them from the Space. Verb.
space_member_role_give_failed: Shown when a role couldn't be given, unless the API gave a reason. {name} is the member's name, {role} the role's.
space_member_role_take_failed: Shown when a role couldn't be taken away, unless the API gave a reason. {role} is the role's name, {name} the member's.
space_member_roles: Heading of a member's roles, each with a switch.
space_members_bot: [short] Badge after a bot's name. Shown in capitals.
space_members_capped: Under Space settings › Members, when the Space has more members than the list loads.
space_members_count: Heading of the members list, in capitals: how many members the Space has.
space_members_count_found: Heading of the members list while a search or a filter is on, in capitals: how many of the Space's members match.
space_members_menu: A screen reader's name for the menu a right-click on a member opens.
space_members_no_match: The members list when nobody matches the search or the filter.
space_members_role_all: [short] The role filter's first choice: members with any role.
space_members_role_none: [short] The role filter's last choice: members with no role.
space_members_search: A screen reader's name for the field that searches the members list under Space settings › Members. Verb.
space_members_sort: A screen reader's name for the menu that picks how the members list is sorted. Verb.
space_members_sort_name: [short] A choice of the members list's sort.
space_members_sort_newest: [short] A choice of the members list's sort: who joined last, first.
space_members_sort_oldest: [short] A choice of the members list's sort: who joined first, first.
space_overview_about: Heading of the Space's name, description and locale in its overview.
space_overview_banner: Label of the Space's banner: the wide image at the top of its room list.
space_overview_banner_alt: A screen reader's name for the Space's banner image. Lowercase, as the English is.
space_overview_banner_crop: Title of the image editor for the Space's banner.
space_overview_banner_none: In the banner's place once it's marked to be removed.
space_overview_banner_set: [short] Button that picks a banner for the Space. Verb.
space_overview_icon_alt: A screen reader's name for the Space's icon image. Lowercase, as the English is.
space_overview_icon_crop: Title of the image editor for the Space's icon.
space_overview_icon_set: Tooltip of the button that picks an icon for the Space. Verb.
space_overview_id: Under the Space's images in its overview. {id} is the Space's ID, a code.
space_overview_image_discard: [short] Tooltip of the button that drops a newly picked banner or icon before it's saved. Verb.
space_overview_image_remove: [short] Tooltip of the button that removes the Space's banner or icon. Verb.
space_overview_image_undo: [short] Button that keeps a banner or icon that was marked to be removed. Verb.
space_overview_locale: Label of the field for the Space's own language code (e.g. en). It's the Space's, not the app's language.
space_overview_new_members: Heading of what a Space sets for members who join it.
space_overview_notifications_all: [short] A choice of the default notifications: members are notified of every message.
space_overview_notifications_mentions: [short] A choice of the default notifications: members are notified only when mentioned.
space_overview_save: [short] Button that saves the changes to the Space's overview. Verb.
space_overview_save_failed: Shown when the Space's overview couldn't be saved, unless the API gave a reason.
space_overview_saved: Shown once the Space's overview is saved.
space_role_above_yours: Tooltip of a role's buttons when the role is at or above the person's own highest role.
space_role_clear_color: [short] Button in a role's edit form that removes the role's colour when it saves (it turns red while on). Verb: clear means remove, not transparent.
space_role_color_from: [short] Label of a role colour's first colour well.
space_role_color_from_title: Tooltip of a role colour's first colour well.
space_role_color_to: [short] Label of the last colour well of a role's gradient.
space_role_color_to_title: Tooltip of the last colour well of a role's gradient.
space_role_color_via: [short] Label of the middle colour well of a role's gradient.
space_role_color_via_title: Tooltip of the middle colour well of a role's gradient.
space_role_create: [short] Button that makes the new role. Verb.
space_role_creating: [short] The Create role button while the new role is made.
space_role_delete_confirm: Asked before deleting a role. {name} is the role's name.
space_role_delete_confirm_unknown: Asked before deleting a role whose name isn't known.
space_role_gradient: [short] Checkbox that makes a role's colour a gradient.
space_role_hoist: Switch that shows a role's members in a group of their own in the members list.
space_role_hoisted: [short] Badge of a role whose members the members list shows as a group of their own.
space_role_no_permissions: Under a role in the roles list, when it grants no permissions.
space_role_permission_not_yours: Tooltip of a permission's switch that the person can't turn on.
space_save: [short] Button and tooltip that save an edited role, emoji or sticker. Verb.
space_saving: [short] A Save button while it saves.
space_section_attachments: [short] A section of a Space's settings: the files uploaded to the Space.
space_section_bans: [short] A section of a Space's settings: the people banned from it. Noun.
space_section_emojis: [short] A section of a Space's settings.
space_section_invites: [short] A section of a Space's settings: its invite links. Noun.
space_section_members: [short] A section of a Space's settings.
space_section_overview: [short] A section of a Space's settings: its name, images and description.
space_section_roles: [short] A section of a Space's settings.
space_section_stickers: [short] A section of a Space's settings.
space_section_storage: [short] A section of a Space's settings: the storage buckets its files go to.
space_section_webhooks: [short] A section of a Space's settings.
space_settings_name: The name of a Space's settings window, for its title bar and screen readers. {name} is the Space's name.
space_settings_name_unknown: The name of a Space's settings window before its Space is known.
space_settings_title: Under the Space's name at the top of its settings' side panel.
space_settings_unknown_space: In place of the Space's name at the top of its settings, before the Space is known.
space_sticker_crop: Title of the image editor for a new sticker's image.
space_sticker_delete_confirm: Asked before deleting one of a Space's stickers. {name} is the sticker's name.
space_sticker_delete_confirm_unknown: Asked before deleting a sticker whose name isn't known.
space_sticker_name: A screen reader's name for the field where a sticker is renamed.
space_sticker_name_placeholder: Placeholder of the new sticker's name field: an example name, in lowercase with underscores.
space_sticker_rename_failed: Shown when a sticker couldn't be renamed, unless the API gave a reason.
space_sticker_upload_title: Heading of the form that uploads a new sticker to the Space. Verb.
space_storage_wait_transfer: Tooltip of the move files button while files are already being moved between buckets.
space_storage_warning_logged: A point of the warning above the storage buckets. The words in … are bold; keep the tags.
space_storage_warning_own: The warning above the storage buckets, which three points follow. The words in … are bold; keep the tags.
space_storage_warning_read: A point of the warning above the storage buckets. The words in … are bold; keep the tags.
space_storage_warning_revoke: A point of the warning above the storage buckets. The words in … are bold; keep the tags.
space_unknown_user: In place of the name of someone who made an invite or started moving files, when they aren't in the Space any more.
space_upload: [short] Button that uploads a new emoji or sticker. Verb.
space_upload_first: Under an empty emoji or sticker list, for those who may upload.
space_upload_image: Label of the button that picks a new emoji's or sticker's image. Noun.
space_upload_image_change: Tooltip of the button that picks another image for the new emoji or sticker.
space_upload_image_choose: Tooltip of the button that picks the new emoji's or sticker's image.
space_upload_name: Label of the new emoji's or sticker's name field. Noun.
space_uploading: [short] The Upload button while the image goes up, before its progress is known.
status_change_failed: A notice after changing the user's status failed.
status_dnd: [short] A status the user can choose: no sounds, calls don't ring.
status_dnd_note: Under Do not disturb in the status menu.
status_menu_label: The profile row's button, which opens the status menu, for a screen reader. {name} is the user's name; status is the status they chose (dnd: Do not disturb, other: Online); each case is the whole label.
status_online: [short] A status the user can choose.
status_online_note: Under Online in the status menu.
storage_bucket_delete_failed: Shown in the dialog when deleting a bucket and its files failed and the API gave no reason. A bucket is S3-compatible storage the files are kept in.
storage_bucket_files_delete: [short] A button: delete the bucket's files (one or several) along with the bucket.
storage_bucket_files_deleting: [short] The delete button while the bucket and its files are being deleted.
storage_bucket_files_description: Under the title of the dialog shown when a bucket that still has files is deleted: one of your own buckets. {name} is the bucket's name; it and them are the files (one, or several).
storage_bucket_files_description_space: As storage_bucket_files_description, for a Space's bucket: the Space's custom emojis and stickers are made from its files, so they go too. {name} is the bucket's name.
storage_bucket_files_move: [short] A button: opens the dialog that moves the bucket's files (one or several) to another storage. The dialog follows, hence the ellipsis.
storage_bucket_files_title: The title of the dialog shown when a bucket can't be deleted because files are still in it. {count} is how many.
storage_cancel: [short] The button that closes a storage dialog (moving files, a bucket's files) without doing anything.
storage_close: [short] The label read out for the × button that closes a storage dialog.
storage_default_name: The name of the storage Duvet keeps files in when no bucket of the user's or the Space's gets them, where it's named on its own: an option among the buckets' names. The sentences that mention it say it in words of their own (a select's default case).
storage_file_reason_not_in_source: Why a file couldn't be moved to another storage, under its name in the list of files that failed: the storage it was in doesn't have it. Lower case, no full stop.
storage_file_reason_other_content: Why a file couldn't be moved to another storage, under its name in the list of files that failed: the storage it was in holds other bytes than were uploaded. Lower case, no full stop.
storage_file_reason_refused: Why a file couldn't be moved to another storage, under its name in the list of files that failed: a bucket refused to give it (side: source, the storage it was in) or to take it (other: the target, the storage it goes to). why: refused, it refused the bucket's keys; missing, there's no such bucket at its address; status, it answered with an error, {status} being an HTTP status code, e.g. 403; other, it didn't answer. Lower case, no full stop. Each case is the whole reason.
storage_file_reason_source_size: Why a file couldn't be moved to another storage, under its name in the list of files that failed: the storage it was in has it at another size than was uploaded. Lower case, no full stop.
storage_file_reason_target_has_other: Why a file couldn't be moved to another storage, under its name in the list of files that failed: the storage it goes to already has another file under the same name (its key). Lower case, no full stop.
storage_file_reason_target_size: Why a file couldn't be moved to another storage, under its name in the list of files that failed: the storage it went to kept it at another size. Lower case, no full stop.
storage_files_select_all: [short] A checkbox over a storage's list of files: picks every file shown. A verb.
storage_kind_audio: [short] A filter chip over a list of stored files: show the sound files.
storage_kind_images: [short] A filter chip over a list of stored files: show the pictures.
storage_kind_other: [short] A filter chip over a list of stored files: show the files that are neither pictures, videos nor sound.
storage_kind_videos: [short] A filter chip over a list of stored files: show the videos.
storage_move_activate_failed: A notice: the move of files to another storage started, but making that storage the one new uploads go to failed. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {name}. {reason} is the API's reason, or storage_move_activate_failed_unknown.
storage_move_activate_failed_unknown: Fills {reason} in storage_move_activate_failed when the API gave none. Lowercase: it follows a colon mid-sentence.
storage_move_button: [short] The move dialog's button that starts the move. {count} is how many files go.
storage_move_egress_note: At the bottom of the move dialog, when the files leave a bucket. {name} is the bucket's name. R2 is Cloudflare's storage service: a brand, not translated. Egress: data going out of the provider's network, which some providers bill.
storage_move_from: Under the move dialog's title. from: default, when the files leave the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {name}. {size} is their total size, e.g. 3.25 MB.
storage_move_from_unknown: As storage_move_from, when the storage the files leave isn't known. {size} is their total size.
storage_move_keep_originals: A checkbox's label, for moving files out of a bucket: copy them and leave the originals in the bucket. {name} is the bucket's name.
storage_move_keep_originals_note: Under storage_move_keep_originals: them are the original files left in the bucket.
storage_move_make_active: A checkbox's label: also make the target storage the one new uploads go to. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {name}.
storage_move_make_active_note: Under storage_move_make_active: there is that storage.
storage_move_no_target: In the move dialog when the files have nowhere else to go. A bucket is S3-compatible storage the user adds.
storage_move_none_fit: In the move dialog: every file is larger than the target storage takes. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {name}. {limit} is its largest file size, e.g. 100.00 MB.
storage_move_size_free: Under the target picker: {size} is the total size of the files that go, {free} the space the target has left.
storage_move_size_no_limit: Under the target picker: {size} is the total size of the files that go. The target has no total limit.
storage_move_size_too_big: Under the target picker, as an error: the files that go ({size}) are more than the target has left ({free}).
storage_move_skipped: Under the target picker: {count} files are larger than the target storage takes, so they're left where they are. "its" is the target's; {limit} is its largest file size. from: default, when the files come from the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {name}.
storage_move_skipped_unknown_source: As storage_move_skipped, when the storage the files come from isn't known.
storage_move_start_failed: In the move dialog when a move of files between storages couldn't start and the API gave no reason.
storage_move_start_failed_more_needed: In the move dialog when the files don't fit in the target storage. {reason} is why it didn't start (the API's words, or storage_move_start_failed); {size} is how much more space the files need, e.g. 3.25 MB.
storage_move_starting: [short] The move button while the move is being started.
storage_move_target_active: An option in the picker of the storage the files go to: the storage that gets new uploads now. {name} is its name.
storage_move_title: The title of the dialog that moves files from one storage to another. {count} is how many files.
storage_move_to_label: [short] The label of the picker of the storage the files go to.
storage_transfer_bytes: The second line of a file move's card. from: default, when the files leave the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; named, when they leave a bucket whose name is in {source}; other, when the bucket's name isn't known (another bucket). {moved} and {total} are sizes, e.g. 1.20 MB of 3.25 MB.
storage_transfer_bytes_started_by: As storage_transfer_bytes, when someone else started the move. {name} is who did.
storage_transfer_cancel: [short] A button on the card of a move of files: stop the move.
storage_transfer_cancel_failed: A notice when stopping a move of files between storages failed and the API gave no reason.
storage_transfer_cancelled: A notice once a move of files between storages was stopped by someone. {moved} of {total} files moved before it did.
storage_transfer_cancelled_to: As storage_transfer_cancelled, with where the files were going. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {target}.
storage_transfer_cancelling: [short] The file move card's Cancel button once pressed, while the move stops after the file it's on.
storage_transfer_done: A notice once a move of files between storages ended with every file moved. {count} is how many moved.
storage_transfer_done_partly: A notice once a move of files ended with some left behind. {moved} of {total} moved; left says which stayed: failed (couldn't be moved), skipped (too large for the target), or other: both, with their counts {failed} and {skipped}.
storage_transfer_done_partly_to: As storage_transfer_done_partly, with where they went. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {target}.
storage_transfer_done_to: As storage_transfer_done, with where they went. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {target}.
storage_transfer_failed: A notice once a move of files between storages stopped on an error. {moved} of {total} files moved before it did.
storage_transfer_failed_reason: As storage_transfer_failed, with why it stopped in {reason}: one of the storage_transfer_reason_ messages, already in your language and in lower case, or the API's own words (in English) when the app doesn't know them.
storage_transfer_failed_to: As storage_transfer_failed, with where the files were going. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {target}.
storage_transfer_failed_to_reason: As storage_transfer_failed_reason, with where the files were going. to: default, the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {target}.
storage_transfer_failures_description: Under storage_transfer_failures_title. {count} is how many files didn't move. from: default, when they're still in the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words; other, a bucket, whose name is {name}.
storage_transfer_failures_description_un: As storage_transfer_failures_description, when the storage they're still in isn't known. English writes "where they were" for one file too.
storage_transfer_failures_empty: In the list of the files a move couldn't move, when it has none.
storage_transfer_failures_load_failed: In the list of the files a move couldn't move, when that list didn't load and the API gave no reason.
storage_transfer_failures_load_more: [short] A button under the list of the files a move couldn't move: show the next ones.
storage_transfer_failures_show: [short] A button on the notice that a move of files ended with failures: lists the files that didn't move. A verb.
storage_transfer_failures_title: The title of the list of the files a move between storages couldn't move.
storage_transfer_progress: The first line of the card of a move of files between storages. state: queued (waiting for its turn) or moving. to: default, when the files go to the default storage (storage_default_name), said in the sentence's own words, with the article or preposition your language needs; named, when they go to a bucket whose name is in {target}; other, when the bucket's name isn't known (another bucket). {done} of {total} files are done; the last part is the percent of the bytes moved. <dot>·</dot> is a separator drawn in a lighter colour: keep the tags. English writes "files" even for 1/1, as a count of a total; your language may need a one case.
storage_transfer_reason_bucket_gone: Why a move of files between storages stopped: one of its two buckets was removed. It follows "Moving files failed:" (storage_transfer_failed_reason): lower case, no full stop.
storage_transfer_reason_internal: Why a move of files between storages stopped: something went wrong on Duvet's side. It follows "Moving files failed:" (storage_transfer_failed_reason): lower case, no full stop.
storage_transfer_reason_target_full: Why a move of files between storages stopped: the storage the files go to has no room left. It follows "Moving files failed:" (storage_transfer_failed_reason): lower case, no full stop.
storage_transfer_reason_unreachable: Why a move of files stopped, or a file of it failed: a bucket of the move couldn't be reached. It follows "Moving files failed:" (storage_transfer_failed_reason), or stands under a file's name: lower case, no full stop. side: source, the storage the files leave; other, the target, the storage they go to. why: refused, it refused the bucket's keys; missing, there's no such bucket at its address; status, it answered with an error, {status} being an HTTP status code, e.g. 503; kept_nothing, it took a file and kept nothing; other, it didn't answer. Each case is the whole reason.
window_settings: The title of the Settings window, shown in Mission Control, the Dock, the taskbar and Alt-Tab. Duvet is the app's name.
window_space_settings: The title of a Space's settings window, shown in Mission Control, the Dock, the taskbar and Alt-Tab. {name} is the Space's name, as its owner wrote it.
window_space_settings_unnamed: The title of a Space's settings window when the Space has no name, shown in Mission Control, the Dock, the taskbar and Alt-Tab. The first "Space" stands in for the Space's missing name: the same title as window_space_settings, with your word for Space where the name goes.
window_voice_controls: The title of the small window the voice and call controls pop out into, shown in Mission Control, the Dock, the taskbar and Alt-Tab.
window_youtube_player: What a screen reader names the frame a YouTube video plays in, inside a message's embed. YouTube is a brand: keep it as it is.
window_youtube_player_page: The title of the page that holds a YouTube video's player in a message's embed, which a screen reader may read as it enters the player. YouTube is a brand: keep it as it is.
